text: Yes, the JRC map supports the 2023 tree-cover loss claim. The Hansen GFC data detected a 0.7-hectare loss in 2023, which was corroborated by the JRC GFC2020 reference map showing forest cover in the area as of 2020. The JRC map agreed with 100% of the event area, confirming the loss occurred within a previously forested zone. The MGAP 2021 data further identified the area as planted forest (Eucalyptus), not native forest. While the cause or legality of the loss isn’t determined, the evidence confirms the loss happened in 2023.
